h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Asansol

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Asansol

c: Asansol sits in the coal and steel belt of West Bengal, and many of the buyers we hear from here manage company townships, hospitals, schools and staff colonies. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Asansol for these sites as well as municipal parks and housing complexes. We make the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away, and deliver it by road.

Township parks are used by whole families, from shift workers to retired employees who still live in the colony. That means one open gym has to serve very different users. We suggest a layout with gentle machines near the entrance and strength stations further in. The region has very hot summers and a humid monsoon, and industrial dust settles on everything. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats resist rust and are easy to wipe clean. A well-drained base keeps the area usable through the rains.
A township park needs machines that take heavy use for years. The
gives eight people a place to train on one frame. The

provides low-impact, full-body movement that retired residents find comfortable. Pair them with a walker and you have a set that covers most needs. We install each station on a grouted or self-standing base and mark the clear space on the layout drawing.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,530 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply a company township in Asansol?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park plan or photos and the likely number of users. We suggest machines, send a layout drawing and quote, and install after manufacturing at our Vasai factory.

items.q: How do we keep machines clean in an industrial area?
items.a: Wipe them down every week or two in a dusty area and keep moving joints free of dust. The roto-moulded parts and galvanised frames clean easily and resist rust.
Low-impact machines such as the Fun Rider, Fun Walker, Tai Chi and seated twisters. They use body weight, move at the user's own pace and are easy to get on and off.
